Remark
[second-order asymptotics of $\operatorname {Hess}r$]

Source: petersen:page-0240, petersen:page-0241 ↗ lem:pet-ch5-normal-coords-first-order 1. ch5:5.9.27In exponential normal coordinates $x^i$ at $p$: (1) show $(\operatorname {Hess}x^i)_{kl}=\Gamma ^i_{kl}=O(r)$; (2) using $\tfrac 12r^2=\tfrac 12\sum _i(x^i)^2$ and $g=\delta _{ij}+O(r^2)$, show $\operatorname {Hess}\tfrac 12r^2=g+O(r^2)$; (3) show $\operatorname {Hess}r= \tfrac 1rg_r+O(r)$.
